weeks.content:
Sing our class welcome song
Add new claps

Count on fingers as we recite
Catch the fish action

Count down with duck puppets
Sing the waddling song

Act the farmer and the cheese
Circle game

Touch each part as we sing
Speed round

Clap the missing letters
Spell Bingo together

Recite with teapot actions
Pouring action song

Act Peter and Paul with fingers
Fly the birds away and back

Recite and clap the rhythm
One a penny, two a penny

Groups pick and sing rhymes
Clap for every group
